sla_terms_proposed: Uptime: 99.95% monthly for Dedicated reserved pool
Credit schedule: <99.95% and >=99.0% = 10% monthly credit; <99.0% and >=97.0% = 25% credit; <97.0% = 50% credit
Service Credits capped at 100% of monthly dedicated fee

Planned maintenance: 90-day rolling calendar, max 4 hours per maintenance event; notice >=7 days for scheduled maintenance; maintenance exempt from uptime calculation if performed in pre-agreed window
Unplanned maintenance/incident: emergency mitigation plan + postmortem within 72 hours

Support response times: Sev1 (platform down/high business impact) - initial response <=15 minutes, engineering action within 1 hour; Sev2 - initial response <=1 hour, engineering action within 4 hours; Sev3 - initial response <=24 hours
Failover/fallback: automated routing to a compatible model variant in a secondary region with documented performance delta - must be opt-in for compliance reasons
Capacity guarantees: reserved GPU baseline (4x A100-equivalent), autoscale burst limited to 2x baseline with billing surcharge; baseline throughput guaranteed for pinned model versions
procurement_notes:
Legal asked for explicit carve-outs: Force Majeure, scheduled maintenance default windows (Saturdays 02:00-06:00 UTC), and indemnity clause limit to fees paid. Finance requests consumption caps and breakpoints for committed spend.

We proposed a 12-month committed capacity with quarterly usage reviews and right to renegotiate on >30% quarterly growth.
technical_constraints: Must support customer-managed KMS; no model weights leaving VPC; audit logs retention 7 years for security events; SSO via SAML; dedicated KV cache per tenant. Network egress via private peering; zero-trust considerations for SE remote debugging.
poC_results_summary: POC v1 ran on Redwood Dedicated pre-prod: sustained 350 r/min with batching, average p95 42ms, p99 140ms. Bottleneck identified in kernel selection at sequence length 1024; SE recommended quantization profile and kernel optimization. After suggested changes, projected p99 ~110-120ms.
commercial_terms_discussed: 12-month reserved capacity; commit $50k/month for baseline (4x A100-equivalent) + overage pricing at 1.6x list. Option for 6-month ramp credits for early termination. Volume discount tier at $250k ARR.
